notes.title: 2025/01/31 UPDATE
notes.notes:
TrickShot Simulator Update


Fixed an issue where the clear condition was not triggered in the “Hanger” and “Dart” stages.


In these stages, if multiple objects were thrown within a short period, the game sometimes failed to recognize the clear condition even when it was met. This issue has now been fixed.

Reduced performance load when objects approach the goal in certain stages.

notes.title: 2025/01/25 UPDATE
notes.notes:
TrickShot Simulator update


Fixed an issue where achievements were not unlocking.
The issue was caused by multiple achievements unlocking simultaneously, causing one to fail.
Players can now unlock previously failed achievements by restarting the stage after this update.

Fixed an issue with object hitboxes that was causing stages to be incorrectly cleared.

notes.title: 2025/01/21 Update
notes.notes:
TrickShot Simulator Update

Removed V-Sync
This option provided little benefit and caused unintentional high load for some users when turned off. The update will automatically turn V-Sync on for users who had it previously disabled.


Added Low-Load Mode
This option reduces the maximum number of thrown objects that remain in the stage and may solve performance issues for users experiencing slowdowns during extended gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332292/85f0c5c610afa2bda4701eeb40a2bc7482535b74.png

notes.title: 2025/01/18 UPDATE
notes.notes:
TrickShot Simulator Update

Fixed Issue with Right-Click View Movement in Goal Perspective

When in the goal-side perspective, the player's view (throwing direction) could unintentionally change if the right mouse button was pressed. This issue has been fixed to prevent view movement in the goal-side perspective.

Added Replay Quality Settings

You can now select the replay video quality from "Low" or "High" in the Options menu on the start screen.  
Choosing "High" improves the replay video quality but may increase memory usage during gameplay by approximately 1.0 to 1.5 GB. Please be aware of this when selecting the option.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332292/b1ad76e60c6824e137f70134ed1cc7f0a4e8bca6.png

Adjusted Object Colors for Better Visibility on Certain Stages

Fixed Issues with Object Collisions Near Goals

In some stages, collision behavior near the goal caused instability in the movement of thrown objects.
